svg.title: EM as repeated maximisation of a lower bound
svg.desc: The log-likelihood of a one-parameter mixture as a function of the second component's mean, with the lower bounds built by the E-step at the first three EM iterates. Each bound is a parabola that touches the log-likelihood at the current iterate and lies below it elsewhere; the M-step moves to the top of the parabola, where the log-likelihood is higher still.
svg.text: θ (the mean of the second component)
